text: dsh-web-searxng-search 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的自托管 SearXNG 网页搜索 provider。它实现 DSH 的 web 搜索 provider 接口，并通过 ctx.web 注册，再由 bundle 将 web 搜索切换到 searxng。搜索请求发送到配置的 SearXNG 实例，返回的结果会按 URL 去重，也可传递语言、安全搜索级别、分类和引擎选项。适合希望用自己部署的元搜索服务为 DSH 提供网页搜索的人。插件默认连接 localhost:8888，需要配置 SearXNG 实例并启用 JSON 搜索格式；无需厂商账号或 API Key。

dsh-web-searxng-search connects DSH web search to a self-hosted SearXNG instance. It registers a provider and routes searches to it, deduplicating results by URL. The default endpoint is localhost:8888. Enable JSON search on SearXNG; no vendor account or API key is required.
想让 DSH 网页搜索使用我自己部署的 SearXNG。
Can I route DSH web searches through my own SearXNG server?
DSH 搜索想避开厂商的搜索接口，改用自己的元搜索服务。
dsh-web-searxng-search 的功能「自托管搜索」：插件注册 SearXNG provider 并切换 DSH Web 搜索。触发 web_search 后，查询发往配置的实例，结果按 URL 去重。
dsh-web-searxng-search 会把搜索查询发送到配置的 SearXNG 实例；默认地址为本机 localhost:8888。插件不要求厂商 API Key，实例若启用了认证可配置 Bearer token。

dsh-web-searxng-search README · dsh-web-searxng-search：**Self-hosted SearXNG web search provider for DeepSeek Harness.**

[](LICENSE)

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Points the `web_search` tool at a [SearXNG](https://docs.searxng.org/) instance you operate.
No API key, no vendor account, no per-query attribution.

dsh-web-searxng-search README · Motivation：DeepSeek Harness ships a web search provider backed by the DeepSeek API, so every search is
billed and attributed to an API key. This plugin registers a second provider on the same
`ctx.web` seam and switches the seam to it. Search then runs against infrastructure you control
and requires no vendor credential.

dsh-web-searxng-search README · Features：- Drop-in `WebSearchProvider` on the `ctx.web` seam — the built-in `web_search` tool keeps working.
- No runtime dependencies of its own; the official `@deepseek-ai/*` packages are peer
  dependencies served by the host.
- Configurable timeout, language, safe-search level, categories and engine allow-list.
- Results deduplicated by URL — meta-search engines return the same page more than once.
- Distinguishes *"the instance returned HTML"* (JSON format not enabled) from *"no results"*,
  with an actionable error message.
- Registration is an effect (`ctx.effect`), so unload and HMR roll back cleanly.
- 14 offline unit tests — no network required.

dsh-web-searxng-search README · Requirements：| Component | Version / note |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web` `0.1.x` |
| Node.js | `>= 22.19` |
| SearXNG | JSON format enabled (see below) |

dsh-web-searxng-search README · Enable the SearXNG JSON API：The plugin reads the [SearXNG search API](https://docs.searxng.org/dev/search_api.html). JSON
output is **disabled by default**; without it the instance answers `200` with an HTML page, which
the plugin reports as a configuration error rather than as "no results".

```yaml

dsh-web-searxng-search README · settings.yml：search:
  formats:
    - html
    - json
```

Verify the endpoint before installing:

```bash
curl -fsS 'http://localhost:8888/search?q=test&format=json' | head -c 120
```
dsh-web-searxng-search README · Installation：```bash
dsh-web-searxng-search README · from npm：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-web-searxng-search
dsh-web-searxng-search README · from GitHub：dsh plugin --profile web add github:kkgace/dsh-web-searxng-search

dsh-web-searxng-search README · from a local checkout：dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-web-searxng-search
```

Then restart the web app:

```bash
dsh web
```

Once listed, the plugin can also be installed from **Settings → Plugin Market**.

dsh-web-searxng-search README · Configuration：The bundle ships a working default of `http://localhost:8888`. Point it at your own instance
with a profile overlay — **patch the existing row, never insert a new one**:

```yaml

dsh-web-searxng-search README · ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml：- id: web-search-searxng
  config:
    baseURL: 'https://searxng.example.com'
```

Alternatively, set `SEARXNG_BASE_URL` in the environment `dsh` runs in.

dsh-web-searxng-search README · ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml：| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `baseURL` | `string` | `http://localhost:8888` | Root URL of the instance, without a trailing `/search`. |
| `timeoutMs` | `number` | `15000` | Per-request timeout, 1000–120000 ms. |
| `language` | `string` | — | UI language forwarded to the instance, e.g. `en-US`. |
| `safeSearch` | `0 \| 1 \| 2` | `0` | Off · moderate · strict. |
| `categories` | `string` | — | Comma-separated SearXNG categories, e.g. `general,it`. |
| `engines` | `string` | — | Comma-separated engine names to narrow the search. |
| `apiKey` | `string` | — | Bearer token, only if the instance requires one. |

dsh-web-searxng-search README · How it works：1. Everything in Harness is a Cordis plugin, and capabilities are exposed as *seams*. Web search
   is the `ctx.web` seam.
2. The plugin implements the `WebSearchProvider` contract — `id`, `available(): boolean` (local
   and cheap, never touches the network) and `search(req, signal?)` — and registers itself with
   `ctx.web.registerSearchProvider(...)` inside `ctx.effect(...)`.
3. Registration alone is not enough: `cordis.patch.yml` switches `web.searchProvider` to
   `searxng`. Without that step the seam stays on the built-in provider.
4. Failures are raised as `WebError(message, code, { cause })` so the host routes them instead of
   silently falling back to another provider.

dsh-web-searxng-search README · Development：```bash
npm test        # node --test tests/*.test.mjs
```

The tests mock `globalThis.fetch` and never touch the network. The official `@deepseek-ai/*`
packages are peer dependencies provided by the host; to run the tests outside a Harness profile,
make them resolvable from `node_modules`.

dsh-web-searxng-search README · Troubleshooting：| Symptom | Cause / fix |
|---|---|
| `web_search` still uses another provider | `web.searchProvider` does not point at `searxng`, or `dsh web` was not restarted. |
| `duplicate loader entry id: web-search-searxng` at boot | The profile overlay `insert`s a row the bundle already inserts. Use the `- id: …` + `config:` patch form instead. |
| "No results" while the instance returns data | JSON format is not enabled on the instance. |
| `WEB_PROVIDER_CONFIGURED_UNAVAILABLE` | `available()` returned false — `baseURL` is not an absolute `http(s)` URL. |
| `WEB_PROVIDER_TIMEOUT` | The instance did not respond within `timeoutMs`. |
